usage: The word '過程' refers to the sequence of actions or steps taken to achieve a particular result.
It is commonly used to describe stages in work, study, or any series of events.
You can use it when explaining how something develops over time or how to complete a task.
It often appears in both formal and informal contexts to emphasize the importance of the method or flow rather than just the outcome.
The phrase is flexible enough to talk about physical processes as well as abstract procedures.
